theme_name.description: The name of the GTK theme to apply globally via mate-tweak.

icon_theme_name.description: The name of the icon theme to apply globally via mate-tweak.

enable_daemon.description: Whether to run the mate-tweak helper daemon in the background.

background_image.description: File path to the desktop background image.

cursor_theme.description: The name of the cursor theme to apply.

font_name_title.description: Font specification for window title bars.

font_name_text.description: Font specification for regular interface text.

font_name_monospace.description: Font specification for terminal and code fonts.

enabled_plugins.description: List of MATE desktop plugins to enable by default. Flat list of plugin names/identifiers.

hidden_apps.description: List of application desktop file names to hide from the main menu. Flat list of .desktop basenames.

enable_global_menu.description: Whether to enable the global menu integration for MATE applications.
